title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 43 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 43)

content.overview: Section 43 applies the Limitation Act, 1963 to arbitrations as it applies to proceedings in Court. It also specifies the statutory commencement rule by reference to section 21 and contains special rules for limitation consequences following court orders relating to awards or fresh arbitration.
